property_summary: On a fresh Cooler contract, approveTransfer always reverts (OnlyApproved) and never sets the approvals entry, because only the (nonzero) lender of a loan may approve.
On a fresh Cooler with no loans, approveTransfer always reverts and never changes the approvals mapping.
For any principal up to 1e18, interest rate at most 100% per year and duration at most one year, the computed interest never exceeds the principal (interestFor(a,r,d) <= a).
With a zero interest rate, interestFor returns zero principal growth: for any principal and duration, interestFor(amount, 0, duration) == 0.
For any amount and rate, interestFor with a zero-duration term yields zero interest, i.e. interestFor(amount, rate, 0) == 0 for all inputs.

interestFor is monotone non-decreasing in duration and in amount: for d1<=d2 and any amount, interestFor(amount,rate,d1) <= interestFor(amount,rate,d2), and interestFor(2*amount,rate,d) >= interestFor(amount,rate,d).
On a Cooler with no loans, setDirectRepay always reverts (OnlyApproved) for any caller and any arguments, leaving repayDirect unset.

For any principal, rate and duration, the interest computation is (up to rounding) homogeneous of degree one: doubling the principal at most doubles the interest, i.e. interestFor(2a,r,d) is between 2*interestFor(a,r,d) and 2*interestFor(a,r,d)+1.

For any principal, rate and duration with rate <= 1e18 and duration <= 365 days, interestFor never exceeds the principal itself (zero-rate means zero interest, and the interest fraction is at most 100%).
For any amount and duration, interestFor(amount, 1e18, duration) equals floor(amount * duration / 365 days), i.e. a 100% annual rate yields exactly principal times the elapsed-year fraction.
interestFor is monotonically non-decreasing in duration: for any principal and rate, a longer term never yields less interest than a shorter one.
